L.n: Plot / site plan from land authority
L.d: Affection plan (Dubai), site plan / plot verification (Abu Dhabi), cadastral survey decision (KSA Balady), plot plan (RAK).
Plot development controls: land use, GFA / FAR, height, setbacks, parking ratio, access points, utility corridors.
Master developer or community authority NOC and approved design-guideline compliance letter.
Appointment letter; consultant registration / classification with the authority; engineer licences (SCE membership in KSA).
Contractor trade licence and authority classification; contract / appointment letter; contractor undertaking.
Contractor all-risk and third-party liability; KSA: inherent defects insurance (IDI) where required, issued via Balady.
Authority fees; owner / consultant / contractor undertakings; bank guarantee or deposit where required.
Application form; project information sheet; area statement (GFA / BUA / plot coverage) in the authority template.
Escrow account agreement, project registration form, construction programme, SPA template, developer and project bank details.
Drawings, models and documents in the authority's required e-submission format: CAD / BIM standard, layer and title-block template, file naming, PDF and sheet sizes, digital signatures.
Location plan; site plan with plot boundary, coordinates (local grid), setbacks, access, levels and neighbouring plots.
All floor plans incl. basement, podium, typical, roof; room names, areas, dimensions, grid; authority title block.
All elevations and min. two sections; heights to datum (DMD / local datum), floor-to-floor, parapets, materials.
GFA / BUA / NLA statement and diagrams per authority definitions; FAR and plot-coverage checks.
Parking layout and numbers vs. ratio; ramps, slopes, turning circles, loading bays, accessible bays.
Universal / accessible design compliance report and drawings (Dubai Universal Design Code, SBC 201 accessibility, ADIBC).
Façade drawings, typical wall sections, material schedule, colour / finishes, cladding fire-performance data.
Massing model, 3D views, perspectives and context images (planning and master developer reviews).
Compliance statement against the building code (Dubai Building Code, ADIBC, SBC) and planning regulations.
Unit mix, room data, key-plan schedules, hotel key count or tenancy schedule as relevant.
Layouts and room data to the sector regulator's design guidelines (health, education, hospitality classification, food or pool).
Site investigation: boreholes, lab tests, groundwater, bearing capacity, foundation recommendations.
Topographic survey in local grid and datum, signed by licensed surveyor.
Foundation, framing and slab plans; core / wall layouts; sections and typical details.
Design basis, loads, analysis model output, member design, foundation design; seismic and wind (incl. wind-tunnel for tall buildings).
Shoring system drawings and calcs, dewatering design, neighbour-protection and monitoring plan.
Pile layout, capacities, pile load-test proposal and results.
PT drawings and calcs from PT specialist (DDA / DM separate PT approval).
Independent / peer review certificate where required (tall or complex buildings; KSA technical inspection company).
Load schedule and maximum demand (kW / kVA), diversity, substation / transformer requirement, meter schedule.
Substation and LV room plans, access, ventilation and cable routes per utility standard.
Domestic / irrigation / fire water demand; storage tank sizing; connection point and meter location.
Foul / storm drainage drawings, flow calcs, connection invert levels, interceptor / STP if no network.
Cooling load estimate (TR), ETS room layout, DC provider demand application; or central plant design.
HVAC layouts, schematics, ventilation and smoke-extract basis, plant-room layouts.
Water supply and drainage layouts, risers, schematics.
Power, lighting and earthing layouts; SLDs; emergency power; panel schedules.
Telecom room, duct and riser design per Etisalat / du / TDRA or CST / STC guidelines; FTTH.
LPG / natural gas design from licensed gas contractor; Civil Defence gas approval.
Lift / escalator traffic analysis, specifications, firefighting / evacuation lift details.
Envelope U-values, glazing performance, energy model or compliance calcs (Al Sa'fat, Estidama, Barjeel, SBC 601 / 602).
CCTV coverage plans, camera specs, recording and retention, control room – to the security regulator's standard.
PV layout, capacity, inverter / SLD, grid-connection study by an accredited PV contractor.
Fire strategy report: classification, compartments, egress, fire-fighting access, smoke control, fire-engineering deviations.
Sprinkler, hydrant / hose-reel, fire alarm, emergency lighting, exit signage, fire-pump and tank drawings with calcs.
Occupant load, travel distances, exit widths, refuge areas, stair and lobby pressurisation.
Cladding, insulation, fire-rated doors and systems approved by Civil Defence (listing / certificates).
Fire-tender access route, hard-standing, turning and hydrant positions on site plan.
Trip generation, junction analysis, access / egress design, parking demand, mitigation.
Site access, road / junction modifications, signage and markings, right-of-way works.
Existing utility drawings from all owners; trial pits; diversion / protection proposals.
EIA or environmental screening per emirate / NCEC classification; mitigation and monitoring plan.
CEMP: dust, noise, dewatering discharge, waste, hazardous materials.
Catchment and flood assessment, wadi / flash-flood analysis (critical in Abha, Jeddah, RAK mountains).
Landscape plan, irrigation design and water source (TSE where required).
Building height (AMSL), coordinates (WGS84), crane heights, obstacle lighting proposal.
Refuse room sizing, chute, collection route and vehicle access per municipality guide.
Bathymetric survey, coastal-process and shoreline study, design water levels, marine structure drawings, dredging / reclamation method, navigation assessment.
Protection-zone plan, ground-movement and vibration impact assessment, foundation / shoring interface details, monitoring and trigger plan, method statement near the asset.
Programme, sequencing, temporary works, logistics and site layout plan.
Health and safety plan, site emergency plan, OSHAD (Abu Dhabi) / municipality HSE requirements.
Concrete and material tests, setting-out certificates, stage inspection records.
As-built architectural, structural and MEP drawings, signed by the supervising consultant.
T&C reports for MEP and fire systems, lift certificates, pressure tests, third-party inspections.
Utility energisation / connection certificates (electricity, water, sewer, telecom, DC, gas).
Supervising consultant certificate that works comply with the approved drawings and permit.
Al Sa'fat / Estidama construction / Barjeel / Mostadam completion evidence where applicable.
